scope: Defects surfaced by rebuilding and comparing digests: two in the OMOP publisher on 2026-09-07, and a MEDS layer built without its vocabulary on 2026-09-10. Counts are from the affected build and its reports; each fix is verified by rebuild.

routing_precedence.defect: the routing disjunction was returned unparenthesised, so a caller's AND NOT bound to one branch

dose_overflow.defect: a parsed dose exceeding the target column's range failed the load

surrogate_key_ties.defect: surrogate keys were numbered by row_number over event_id, which is not a total order when one event fans out to several concepts
surrogate_key_ties.found_by: digest comparison of a full rebuild

meds_without_vocabulary.defect: the MEDS stage resolves its term map through OMOP_VOCAB_DIR and, with the variable unset, published every code as SOURCE/ with no concept and no warning; all 39 checks passed on the result
meds_without_vocabulary.found_by: digest comparison of a full rebuild
meds_without_vocabulary.how_it_happened: the meds stage was rerun by hand after an out-of-memory kill, with EHR_WORK_ROOT set and OMOP_VOCAB_DIR not
